_comment: Tier-2 for febio::heat#4, and a CORRECTION to its last clause. Omitting the 'zero fluid velocity' BC reproduces exactly as claimed: read SUCCESS, '------- failed to converge at time : 1', 0 completed steps, error termination, exit 1. But the claim's closing clause 'the logged temperature field is all zeros' is wrong on the shipped deck: the CSV holds one *Step = 0 block carrying the INITIAL CONDITION (300 everywhere). It is zeros only when the <Initial> block is removed as well, which the fixture executes as a third variant. So 'all zeros' is not a usable detection rule and the pitfall was amended. Positive control: the shipped heat_3d_bar / biphasic_3d_confined template, unmodified, which runs to normal termination — so the message is attributable to the single thing that was changed. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'thermofluid_free_velocity=reproduced_with_correction' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
